meta.name: Vietnamese Calendar Golden Dataset v2.1

rules.truc: instant-aware solar-term month is normative; record field trucAtLocalNoon is only the snapshot at 12:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
rules.solarTerm: solar longitude at local noon; exact transition-minute testing must use dedicated transition fixtures
rules.hoangDaoDay: 12 day-gods by lunar month; Thanh Long starts Tý for months 1/7, Dần for 2/8, Thìn for 3/9, Ngọ for 4/10, Thân for 5/11, Tuất for 6/12
rules.directions: versioned lookup by day stem; Kỷ Tài Thần = Chính Nam in v2.1

reviewNotes: Cát/Hung thần and activity advice remain excluded.
For 12 Trực, exact transition-instant tests are authoritative. A whole-day API may intentionally differ on a crossing day and must be labeled as a presentation convention, not an exact rule.
Solar-term field remains a local-noon regression value, not an exact transition timestamp.
v2_1Changes: Corrected Hoàng/Hắc Đạo month offset to forward +2 branches per lunar month (repeating after six months).
Changed Tài Thần for day stem Kỷ from Chính Bắc to Chính Nam.
Canonicalized Câu Trần; Câu Trận retained only as an alias.
Clarified that 12 Trực is instant-aware at solar-term crossings. Existing Golden records remain local-noon snapshots.
